# Daverion Digital

> Independent Swiss app studio (Daverion Digital KLG). We build and grow our own mobile apps — apps that make people's lives better every day.

Daverion Digital is an app studio, not an agency. We design, build, launch and market our own apps in-house, like TradeLens and SportLens. Based in Kilchberg near Zurich, Switzerland.

Also known as: Daverion, Daverion Digital KLG, Daverion Studio, Daverion App Studio.

## Apps

### TradeLens

TradeLens (also: TradeLens App, TradeLens Pro, TradeLens AI) is an iOS app by Daverion Digital for AI chart analysis and technical analysis. Traders upload a chart screenshot and receive long/short signals, news analysis and a complete trading plan. Supports stocks, crypto, forex and commodities. Daverion Digital built, launched and grew TradeLens past 35,000 downloads with an in-house marketing strategy. Contact: tradelens@daverion.digital

### SportLens

SportLens is an iOS sports analysis app by Daverion Digital, coming soon to the App Store. It shows win chances and fair odds for every game across the NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB and top European football, compares them with the average bookmaker price, and includes Scout, an AI betting mentor that explains every pick. For adults 18+. Contact: help@daverion.digital
